note: Tidecaller Tideguard (unit identity, Tidecallers): drowned, biped, upright; bleached coral rising from both shoulders, a bronze scale cuirass over barnacled mail, a scallop shell on the back, a verdigris finned cap with the team fin, a barry-wavy team tabard, team wraps over bronze bracers, bronze greaves. The coral trident is braced in the right hand. Tier II bronze plate rimmed in sea blue; tier III deep sea-blue plate chased in warm bronze, pearl rivets and a crown of coral sprigs. No back flag.
